title: Stir-Fried Midnight Rice Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful stir-fry made with midnight rice, zhu, yu, and aromatic spices. Serve as a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced aromatic and stir-fry until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the sliced zhu and yu, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes or until they start to soften.
Add the cooked midnight rice to the skillet or wok, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes to combine with the vegetables.
Season with salt to taste, and serve hot.
